text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day—on this day of
celebration where
we give gifts to those
we care for, disaster has
struck.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is awful! The sink ate the

chocolaaate!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was mixing some chocolate in a bowl to
give to
you. But then, I tipped it over by
mistake...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And then the sink swallowed all the
melted
chocolate up. Waaaah!

I attempt to soothe her tears. It sounds
like her
go at making chocolate ended
with her work all
falling down the drain.
choice_data_list: A-Anyway, let's calm down for now.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, I'm so sorry... I'll start all over
again.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it now, so could you come
along to
watch?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, I haven't even tried melting the
chocolate
yet, and I've dropped it
already...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ack, I forgot to buy more chocolate. We
have to
go back to the store.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? My wallet—where is my wallet?
Where did it
go?

At this point, she's running backwards
away from
her goal. We might not see
any chocolate today if
this keeps up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so,
so sorry... All I... All I wanted to
do was
show you my gratitude, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can't even give you one piece of
chocolate.
Uugh, what now?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Cho... chocolate parfaits?
choice_data_list: How about we share a chocolate par...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this looks delicious. The melted
chocolate
is drizzled all over the ice
cream...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay to eat this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!
choice_data_list: It's fine. I ordered enough for two.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, this is so tasty! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... I want to thank you for today. The
parfait
was very delicious...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But, are you okay with things turning out
like
this? I've done nothing but eat
today.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. Well, if you... say so.
choice_data_list: If it tasted good, then that's all...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
I'll turn this chocolate parfait into
fuel for
doing my best! Starting
tomorrow!

Meisho Doto is unable to gift me
chocolate, but I have a wonderful time
eating Valentine's
Day-themed desserts
with her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so, so sorry... I just wanted to show
you my
gratitude, but I couldn't give you
even a single
piece of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
There's no other way...
if I can't give you

chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: THEN TAKE ME INSTEAD!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You know in picture books, how witches
and
monsters gobble people up? I-I
can't promise I'll
taste good, but I'll try!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can't make you chocolate, so I'll
become the
chocolate. Trainer, I am
chocolate!

I can't make sense of what she really
means. After
calming her down, we go in
search for a real
chocolate replacement.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer, there's a poster over at
the arcade.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Why not take some mega-cute photos
this
Valentine's?"

Apparently, you can make some special
stickers
for Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Will that be enough for you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll choose this background... and
have that
go there...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I think this will be okay. Lovey-dovey
things are a bit confusing to me, but I'll
try not to break the
camera in the
process!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Three, two... Happy, sappy,
Valentine's! ♪
Click!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Heehee! Yippee! ☆

In place of chocolate, she gives me a
very cute
sticker sheet. I should stick it
somewhere in my
office.
